text: Okay, so you can't place the new order for me directly. Hmm, yeah, let me think about that. I guess I could just place it myself through the website or app. Yeah, that sounds like the easiest way. I'll check it out. Appreciate your help with the returns though, that was great. Thanks a lot!
zh: 好的，所以您不能直接为我下单新订单。嗯，是的，让我想想。我想我可以自己通过网站或应用下单。是的，那听起来是最简单的方法。我会试试看。不过，非常感谢您处理退货，那太棒了。非常感谢！
